description: Move a held position's stop-loss closer to the current price, e.g. to breakeven or to lock in profit: the new stop is placed first, then the old one is cancelled, so the position is never unprotected. Use when the user asks to raise a long's stop or lower a short's. Not for widening a stop (never allowed while the position is open) or for closing (use close_position). Inputs: symbol, stop_loss (USD per coin), venue. Works while trading is halted. Next: get_my_open_orders to see the new stop.

stop_loss.description: New stop price, USD per coin: closer to the price than the current stop (higher for a long, lower for a short), still on the loss side of the mark

venue.description: Venue: sandbox, hyperliquid, okx, bybit or binance. Omitted: the agent's only venue, else hyperliquid if connected, else your only connected exchange, else the sandbox
